title: 08. Files & Errors: try / except / else / finally
summary: Python's exception handling lets you gracefully deal with errors instead of crashing. The four clauses work together:

sections.title: Explanation (Like You're a Junior Developer)
sections.body:
Python's exception handling lets you **gracefully deal with errors** instead of crashing. The four clauses work together:

```
try:
    ← code that MIGHT raise an exception

except SomeError:
    ← runs if SomeError was raised in try

else:
    ← runs ONLY if NO exception was raised in try

finally:
    ← ALWAYS runs — whether or not an exception occurred
```

**Real-world analogy:** Like a surgery team:
- **try** = perform the surgery (risky operation)
- **except** = if something goes wrong → emergency protocol
- **else** = if surgery successful → move to recovery room
- **finally** = regardless of outcome → clean up the operating room (ALWAYS happens)
